skill.name: zillow-for-sale-rent-and-sold-listing-extractor
skill.description: Search Zillow by city, state or ZIP for active, rental or recently sold listings, with pricing, Zestimate, agent, school, tax and price history for each property. Output fields: address, price, soldPrice, beds, baths and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "Zillow for-sale, rental and sold listings", "Zillow scraper", "real estate comps", or a CSV/JSON export of public Zillow data.
skill.summary: Retrieve public Zillow sale, rental, and sold listing data through an Apify Actor with configurable searches and property details.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 66 static findings are false positives in the reviewed context, including formatting backticks, fixed resource paths, and documented Apify authentication. The runner sends user-selected search input to Apify and can incur account charges. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, destructive operations, or network reconnaissance; the remote Actor implementation was not available for review.

content.user_title: Extract Zillow Sale, Rental, and Sold Listings
content.value_statement: Comparing public Zillow listings manually takes time and creates inconsistent records. This skill prepares searches and retrieves structured property data through an Apify Actor.
actual_capabilities: Configure BUY, RENT, and SOLD searches by city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county, or state.
Accept Zillow property URLs, ZPIDs, and street addresses as lookup inputs.
Set price, bedroom, bathroom, area, property type, and rental filters using the supplied input schema.
Request property enrichment for pricing estimates, agent information, schools, photos, and price or tax history when available.
Submit inline JSON or a local input file through the Node runner and print the returned dataset as JSON.
Follow documented curl workflows for synchronous runs or asynchronous run creation and dataset retrieval.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, internet access, and applicable Actor usage charges.
The local runner requires Node 18+ and returns JSON; CSV conversion requires a separate step.
Remote extraction behavior, field completeness, and data freshness depend on Apify and Zillow; live results were not tested.
Synchronous requests have a documented 300-second limit; asynchronous runs need completion checks before dataset retrieval.

use_cases.title: Prepare Buyer Shortlists
use_cases.description: Collect public for-sale listings within a client budget and compare bedrooms, area, and listing age.

use_cases.title: Compare Rental Inventory
use_cases.description: Retrieve local rental listings with selected amenities and compare asking rents across available properties.

use_cases.title: Study Recent Sales
use_cases.description: Gather recently sold listings and available property histories for neighborhood research, with source URLs retained for verification.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Small Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 10 public for-sale listings in [city, state]. Confirm Apify costs before running and summarize returned prices and source URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Rental Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Search rentals in [ZIP] below [monthly budget] with at least [bedrooms] bedrooms. Limit to 25 records and report unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich Selected Properties
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an input for these Zillow URLs: [URLs]. Request available price history, taxes, and schools; confirm the input before invoking Apify.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Larger Sold Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a SOLD search for [county] capped at [record limit]. Use asynchronous execution after approval, verify completion, and summarize returned records and missing fields.

output_examples.input: Prepare a small for-sale search for Austin, Texas, with full details.
output_examples.output: Prepared search: BUY mode; Austin, TX; maximum 25 properties; full details requested. No live run performed; Apify charges require confirmation.

output_examples.input: Which columns can support a recent-sales comparison?
output_examples.output: Declared fields include address, soldPrice, dateSold, beds, baths, sqft, propertyType, and url. Availability depends on each returned record.

output_examples.input: Plan a large rental export without treating partial results as complete.
output_examples.output: Plan: create an asynchronous RENT run, check status until completion, then retrieve its dataset. Review missing fields before comparison.

best_practices: Start with a small record limit, review the selected Actor and current pricing, and confirm paid execution.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only public search inputs without cookies, sessions, or private account data.
Verify listing URLs, missing fields, and run completion before using exported data; review site terms and applicable law.
anti_patterns: Do not supply private files, account sessions, or credentials as listing input.
Do not treat missing values, estimates, or partially retrieved datasets as verified market facts.
Do not use collected agent or property information for spam, harassment, or unlawful discrimination.

faq.question: Does this skill scrape Zillow locally?
faq.answer: No. The included runner submits search input to an Apify Actor and prints the dataset returned by that service.

faq.question: What do I need to run it?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, and internet access. The Node runner requires Node 18+; documented curl workflows are also available.

faq.question: Is usage free?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Review the current Actor pricing and confirm your budget before starting.

faq.question: Can I search rentals and recently sold homes?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplied schema supports BUY, RENT, and SOLD modes, plus location searches and property lookups.

faq.question: Does it return CSV directly?
faq.answer: The included runner prints JSON. Convert the returned rows separately when you need CSV.

faq.question: Are all property details guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Declared fields describe possible output. Availability, freshness, and completeness depend on the source listing and remote Actor.
